description: Reads the same real-world bet's live price from 2-5 prediction-market venues at once (Kalshi, Polymarket, ADI Predictstreet, Limitless, Myriad) in a single call and reports the spread between the cheapest and most expensive. Takes every venue's identifier together in quotes[], for example one Kalshi ticker and one Polymarket slug for the same bet, and returns the venue with the lowest yes midpoint price, before fees and depth. The caller supplies each venue's own identifier for what they've confirmed is the same underlying bet; this tool never auto-matches events across venues, only reads and compares prices for identifiers you provide. For the odds, breakeven win rate or vig of a single market, see workflow.run_odds_converter. Use when user asks "is this bet priced differently on Kalshi vs Polymarket?" or "which venue has the best price on this?". Returns: quotes[] (venue, identifier, label, probabilityPct, available, error), availableCount, cheapestVenue, mostExpensiveVenue, spreadPct (percentage points, null if fewer than 2 quotes resolved).

quotes.description: One entry per venue you want to compare: 2 to 5 total, all in this one call (a Kalshi ticker and a Polymarket slug for the same bet are two entries). Each must genuinely be the same real-world bet; this tool does not verify that for you.

identifier.description: Kalshi ticker, Polymarket slug, ADI Predictstreet symbol, Limitless slug, or Myriad slug, matching the venue field.

venue.description: Prediction-market venue this quote comes from

name: workflow.run_spread_reader
